description: Atlas do Ambiente - Rede Ferroviária is a dataset listed in data.gov.pt, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Agência Portuguesa do Ambiente. Railways. Coverage: Agência Portuguesa do Ambiente. The portal shows the English title as "Atlas of the Environment - Railway Network" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Agência Portuguesa do Ambiente. Its keywords include apambiente-pt. The listing shows 1 download or service links in ZIP. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-dados-gov-pt.
